items.title: Taylor expansion commutes with approximation trees in distant Bang calculus
items.author: Kostia Chardonnet; Jules Chouquet; Axel Kerinec

items.difficulty_reason: The author coordinates distant explicit-substitution reduction with non-idempotent resource Taylor expansion, proves the simulation and normalisation properties required to recover finite approximants, and proves both inclusions between normal Taylor resources and the Taylor expansion of the approximation tree. The full resource/term simulation and approximant reconstruction proofs are retained. This non-routine approximation-theoretic construction supports H2; adjacent direct applications are not additional items.
